quotes.author: Dan
quotes.text: I would definitely recommend jet-skiing on the inter-coastal. The ocean was rough the day we went and luckily we found a place we could still jet-ski. The equipment was brand new and we had a blast. Had to go slow to get out of the no-wake zone but it was just a short ride to the fast zone. Plus the views while going slow were fantastic, boats, homes, restaurants, lots happening in Pompano Beach!
